This file exists so the source clip can be run on its own. repeats=1, so
ground truth is 7 actions and the times are already absolute: no folding,
no copy boundaries, and every track break is real fragmentation rather
than a hard cut. That makes it the cleaner test bed -- but it also samples
the VLM once instead of four times, so a lucky run reads 100%. Keep scoring
tt6.mp4 as well; that is where VLM variance is visible.
Do not edit these labels to make a score look better. If they disagree with
the pipeline, the pipeline is what is wrong.
_known_limitations: action 'FOLD' is NOT in src/schema/event.py ActionType. The vocabulary has
no word for folding a box flap, which is a real gap for packing tasks, not
a labelling mistake. The scorer reports it as NOT_IN_VOCABULARY rather than
action 7 uses direction 'OFF' for lifting the box and moving it aside. The
template offered no value for a lateral move. That is a shortcoming of the
template, and 'OFF' is kept as written.
